document.title: Form PENS.E/3-A — Spouse Married After Separation: Expression of Interest to Purchase an Annuity

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/3-A — Spouse Married After Separation: Expression of Interest to Purchase an Annuity
chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/3-A is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/3-A expresses a retiree's interest in purchasing an annuity for a spouse married after separation, under article 35 ter.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/3-A — Spouse Married After Separation: Expression of Interest to Purchase an Annuity
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/3-A
chunks.text: Section 1 - Retiree information (including optional retirement number, prefixed 'R/'); Section 2 - Spouse information (name, date of birth, sex, email, phone); Section 3 - Marriage information (date and place of marriage); Section 4 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/3-A — Spouse Married After Separation: Expression of Interest to Purchase an Annuity
chunks.heading: Acknowledgements on form PENS.E/3-A
chunks.text: The retiree confirms interest in purchasing the annuity, confirms being in receipt of a periodic benefit, confirms having read article 35 ter and the form's instructions, requests an estimate, understands the purchase will not proceed without a final election, and confirms enclosing a copy of the marriage certificate and the spouse's valid government-issued photo ID.
